skill.name: onboarding-cro
skill.description: Helps improve post-signup onboarding, user activation, first-run experiences, empty states, and time-to-value for digital products.
skill.summary: Optimize post-signup onboarding so new users reach activation faster.
skill.author: coreyhaines31

content.value_statement: Many products lose new users before they reach first value. This skill helps analyze onboarding flows, improve activation, and plan measurable experiments.
actual_capabilities: Audits post-signup flows for activation barriers, drop-off points, and first-value delays.
Defines activation events, aha moments, and metrics for onboarding success.
Designs guided setup flows, checklists, empty states, tooltips, and progress indicators.
Suggests onboarding experiments for flow simplification, personalization, CTAs, and support.
Drafts onboarding copy for welcome screens, empty states, tooltips, emails, and milestones.
Maps multi-channel onboarding with behavior-triggered email and in-app recovery tactics.
limitations: Does not replace product analytics, cohort analysis, or experiment measurement.
Needs product context, activation data, and current flow details for precise recommendations.
Focuses on post-signup onboarding, not signup form conversion or long-term email programs.
Provides strategy and copy guidance, not implementation code or design files.

use_cases.title: Improve Activation After Signup
use_cases.description: Identify where new users stall and prioritize onboarding changes that shorten time to value.

use_cases.title: Plan Onboarding Experiments
use_cases.description: Create test ideas for checklists, empty states, personalization, and behavior-triggered recovery.

use_cases.title: Write First-Run Copy
use_cases.description: Draft welcome screens, tooltip text, checklist microcopy, and milestone messages for new users.

prompt_templates.title: Audit My Onboarding Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use onboarding-cro to review my current post-signup flow. My product is [product], activation means [event], and users drop off at [step].

prompt_templates.title: Design a First-Value Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use onboarding-cro to design a first-run experience that gets [user segment] to [activation event] in the first session.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Experiment Roadmap
prompt_templates.prompt: Use onboarding-cro to propose onboarding experiments for [product]. Include hypotheses, target metrics, priority, and expected activation impact.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Segmented Activation Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Use onboarding-cro to create onboarding paths for [segments]. Include in-app guidance, email triggers, stalled-user recovery, and measurement.

output_examples.input: A B2B SaaS analytics tool has a 38% activation rate after signup.
output: Finding: Users wait too long before seeing their first report.
Recommendation: Show sample data first, then guide users to connect their own source.
Priority: High, because time to first value directly affects activation.

output_examples.input: A mobile app asks for notification permission immediately after account creation.
output: Finding: The permission request appears before users understand the value.
Recommendation: Request permission after the user completes a meaningful first action.
Metric: Compare opt-in rate, day 1 retention, and activation completion.

output_examples.input: A marketplace shows an empty dashboard after signup.
output: Finding: The empty state does not explain the next useful action.
Recommendation: Add a clear primary CTA, sample content, and a short value explanation.
Priority: Medium, because it may reduce first-session momentum.

best_practices: Define activation as a measurable action that strongly predicts retention.
Focus the first session on one valuable outcome before teaching advanced features.
Measure onboarding changes with cohort data, time to activation, and retention impact.
anti_patterns: Teaching every feature during the first session.
Blocking product access behind long setup steps or forced tours.
Sending generic onboarding emails that ignore in-app behavior.

faq.question: What does this skill help optimize?
faq.answer: It helps improve post-signup onboarding, activation rate, first-run experience, empty states, and time to value.

faq.question: Can it create onboarding copy?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft welcome screens, checklist items, tooltips, empty states, emails, and milestone messages.

faq.question: Does it analyze signup forms?
faq.answer: It focuses on what happens after signup. Use a signup flow skill for registration conversion.

faq.question: What inputs improve the recommendations?
faq.answer: Share the product type, activation event, current flow, drop-off data, user segments, and retention goals.

faq.question: Can it plan onboarding experiments?
faq.answer: Yes. It can suggest hypotheses, success metrics, test priorities, and experiment ideas for onboarding changes.

faq.question: Does it replace analytics tools?
faq.answer: No. It helps interpret onboarding problems and plan changes, but analytics tools must measure the results.
